voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Durban, July nineteen-oh-nine. A passenger left the liner Waratah here. She sailed on without him. No one aboard was ever seen again.
His name was Claude Sawyer. He told the inquiry he had dreamed of a man with a long sword, three times in one night.
He said she rolled heavily, and was slow to come back upright. He thought her top-heavy.
He also said he dreamed she was struck by a great wave, and disappeared.
The inquiry judged she probably capsized in a storm, but could not say how. She has never been found.
